explanation: The thigh bone is roughly a quarter of a person's height, so scientists can estimate how tall someone was from a single femur. The smallest bone, the stapes, sits in the ear.

claims.text: The femur, or thigh bone, is the longest bone in the human body.
The tibia, humerus and fibula are all shorter than the femur.
An adult's femur is roughly a quarter of their height.
Scientists can estimate a person's height from the length of a femur.
The stapes, in the middle ear, is the smallest bone in the human body.
